title: Dreamstate playbook frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter contract for every file in playbooks/. The build validates each playbook against this and fails CI on a violation.

name.description: Kebab-case skill id, prefixed dreamstate-. Becomes the slash-command / skill name.

description.description: Triggering description. Says what it does AND when to use it. A little pushy on purpose, since agents under-trigger skills.

platforms.description: Which agent clients this playbook installs into.

min_mcp_version.description: Minimum Dreamstate MCP version whose compact gateway tools this playbook needs. Pinned against contracts/capability-manifest.json.

domain.description: Primary domain, used for grouping in the index and the install picker.

tools_used.description: Every compact MCP gateway or run-control tool this playbook calls. Each must exist in contracts/capability-manifest.json.

capability_ids.description: The explicit bounded canonical capabilities this playbook may discover or execute.

tier.description: capability = thin single-tool helper; composite = a few tools; playbook = end-to-end outcome.
